snippet.title: Nick Eh 30 going off the rails in GTA 6 is the funniest thing I've seen all week 😂
snippet.description:
Joe Bartolozzi is reacting to Nick's "family-friendly" GTA plan, and it falls apart fast. Nick starts out running as far as possible, then the plan turns into something way more chaotic, with a boat, a beach and a lot of half-finished ideas along the way. Joe keeps losing it on the mic while trying to explain what Nick was thinking.

The frames show Joe laughing, gesturing and reacting to every twist, so if you've been following Nick's GTA 6 streams, this one is worth watching all the way through. Tell me in the comments what you think Nick was actually going for, because I'm still not sure.

#GTA6 #NickEh30 #StreamReaction #JoeBartolozzi #GTA
